title: Nourishing Pillowy Ethiopian Lentils Misir Wot
description: A traditional Ethiopian lentil stew made with red lentils, onions, garlic, and spices, slow-cooked to perfection, featuring a hint of lemon and ayurvedic-rajasic friendly ingredients, this dish is perfect for a comforting meal prep option.
instructions: In a large pot, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute.
Add the red lentils, water, salt, and black pepper, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Stir in the lemon juice and continue to simmer for another 10 minutes.
Serve the misir wot hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
